body:
My mother drug tests me, I read about putting 6ml in a 60cc sample of urine. She uses Home Marijuana Test Kits that she buys at pharmacies.
I had smoked 2 bowls of headies weed on friday night, for the first time in over 2 weeks (I know I was clean previously because I had been drugtested by her 3 days before I smoked again, and I passed). Saturday night, I smoked another bowl. Sunday morning I ate a poptart with about .5 grams of shwagg cooked in. Tuesday, I was tested.
So, I put approximatly 6ml of visine in the urine (slightly diluted because I drank 3 cups of water beforehand). I failed.
So people who say that visine yield false negatives are wrong, because in my experience, it does not. I'm 17 years old, weigh 130.
